name: mcp-aauth-codex
description: Use AAuth-protected eDocs MCP tools from Codex

interface.shortDescription: Call AAuth-protected eDocs tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Adds a local stdio MCP proxy that handles AAuth resource challenges, eDocs consent, and authenticated calls to a remote Streamable HTTP MCP server.
